chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 571: Ji Ning Breaks Through to Pure Yang & Commands the Ultimate War God
chapter_meta_description: On the brink of total despair, Ji Ning emerges from heartbreak as a Pure Yang True Immortal. He takes command of a deity that rivals a Daofather. The final, decisive clash begins!
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 571: The Pure Yang Breakthrough
og_description: From a shattered heart to an unstoppable immortal—Ji Ning’s Dark Phoenix moment ignites the final battle for the realmverse.
twitter_title: DE Ch.571: Ji Ning’s Phoenix Rise!
twitter_description: Devastated by betrayal, Ji Ning emerges as a Pure Yang True Immortal to pilot the ultimate Karmic Punishment Deity. The final Realm War clash begins!

lore_anchors.definition: A qualitative leap in cultivation where the immortal's ki, soul, and body are completely purified of mortal dross, granting a massive boost in power and control.
A supreme war construct possessing Daofather-level strength and extreme toughness, virtually indestructible except by a Daofather's personal effort.
Colossal battle avatars formed from coordinated immortal cultivator formations, representing the concentrated might of hundreds of Celestial Immortals and Loose Immortals.
A formless, metaphysical power derived from a cultivator's will and Dao-heart, distinct from Ki or Divine Power; the fourth level allows for unprecedented control over massive formations.
A dragon-shaped war formation composed of 1,000 Celestial Immortals and 100,000 Loose Immortals, capable of devastating coordinated attacks.
A battle formation/divine entity created by Hongxue, described as an elegant, time-distorting combat form.
